mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_deploy_approval WHERE approval_status = #{status} ORDER BY submit_time DESC
SELECT * FROM wf_deploy_approval WHERE submitter_id = #{submitterId} ORDER BY submit_time DESC

SELECT da.* FROM wf_deploy_approval da INNER JOIN wf_deploy_approval_step das ON da.id = das.approval_id WHERE das.step_status = 'PENDING' AND das.approver_type = 'USER' AND FIND_IN_SET( CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(IFNULL(das.approver_ids, ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) > 0 ORDER BY da.submit_time DESC
